## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle anonymous Dūnhuáng-preserved text is a commentary on *Dà bān niè pán jīng* 大般涅槃經 ([KR6g0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0001)). Preserved in Taishō volume 85 (the *Dūnhuáng yíshū*).

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (500–900) reflects the broad pre-Táng to Táng period of Dūnhuáng-fragment composition.
